definitions.explanation: Conjunction expressing contrast or disappointment when reality doesn't match expectation, often with emotional overtone.

examples.japanese: ⟦あんなに→あんなに：01876_annani⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧。それなのに⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I practiced so much. And yet I lost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧。それなのに⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？
examples.english: You promised, didn't you? And yet you didn't come?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ために→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{尽|つ}くした→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。それなのに⟦{裏切|うらぎ}られた→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧。
examples.english: I devoted myself to him. Even so, I was betrayed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧。それなのに⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I warned them. Nevertheless, they made the same mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。それなのに⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当に：04714_hontouni⟧⟦ショック→ショック：03847_shokku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I studied every day. And yet I failed the exam. I'm truly in shock.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧ (that) + ⟦なのに→なのに：22395_nanoni⟧ (despite being).

NUANCE: Carries emotional weight — frustration, disappointment, or indignation. The speaker expected a different outcome from what the first statement led them to expect.

COMPARISON:
・⟦それでも→それでも：00382_soredemo⟧ — "even so" (more neutral; carrying on despite the circumstances)
・それなのに — "and yet" (emotional contrast; an expectation was violated)
・⟦にもかかわらず→にも関わらず：06778_nimokakawarazu⟧ — "despite" (formal, factual)

USAGE PATTERNS:
1. Between sentences: 〜⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。それなのに〜 (I did ~. And yet ~)
2. Complaint: showing frustration that effort went unrewarded
3. Betrayal: when trust has been violated

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly informal. Natural in both speech and writing.

RELATED FORMS:
・⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧ joins clauses inside one sentence: ⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧ (I tried hard, but it was no good). それなのに starts a new sentence instead.
・⟦にもかかわらず→にも関わらず：06778_nimokakawarazu⟧ — more formal "nevertheless"
・⟦それでも→それでも：00382_soredemo⟧ — more accepting "even so"
